_meta.purpose: Real Google reviews source of truth. _review_apply.py renders a visible review block + valid Review schema per page, choosing reviews whose tags match the page service/city, and keeps aggregateRating legitimate (backed by visible reviews).
_meta.source: Google Business Profile, pasted by owner 2026-06-10

reviews.author: Bruno Bernardes
reviews.text: Waterproof vinyl plank in our Bradenton house with two big dogs — looks like real wood and survives everything. Mauricio's quote was honest and the result blew us away.

reviews.author: Lais Lana
reviews.text: Triangle Flooring did our whole Palmer Ranch home — SPC vinyl plank in living areas and bedrooms, porcelain tile in the kitchen and bathrooms. They explained why each material made sense for each room instead of pitching one product for everything. Transition strips between rooms are seamless. Crew finished the entire project in 5 days.

reviews.author: Carole Marinucci
reviews.text: Wonderful service, the floors look absolutely amazing. We will definitely be using Triangle Flooring in future. I have recommended them to all of my friends and family!

reviews.author: Chavezito
reviews.text: We couldn't be more impressed with the value this company delivers. From the initial quote to the final installation, the pricing was transparent, fair, and well below what competitors offered — without any compromise on quality. Highly recommend to anyone looking for premium flooring at an honest price.

reviews.author: Pablo Escobar
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to get to know their work — they are experts with floors. I am very satisfied with the work they gave me. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jon Edmunds
reviews.text: Mauricio does excellent work and takes pride in his craft. He installed laminate wood flooring in three bedrooms and we were very happy. He took the extra step to ensure the floor was level prior to laying it, using self-leveling concrete. The other flooring service I considered didn't even check for level.

reviews.author: Maycon Bernardes
reviews.text: Triangle Flooring did the flooring in a house where I was responsible for the entire brick paver and flooring remodeling project. Mauricio provided a fair estimate and delivered extremely high-quality work. Very satisfied and would definitely recommend their company.

reviews.author: Lucas Augusto
reviews.text: Great experience with this flooring contractor in Venice, FL. The team arrived on time, communicated well and completed the installation with great attention to detail. The floors look incredible and the entire process was smooth from start to finish. Mauricio and his crew were very professional.

reviews.author: Michelle Pio Barbosa da Silva
reviews.text: Highly recommend this flooring company in Bradenton. Very professional crew, fair pricing and outstanding workmanship. The installation was completed on schedule and the final result looks amazing.

reviews.author: Claudemir Nunes
reviews.text: Excellent flooring company in Sarasota. The crew was professional, efficient and delivered amazing results. The new floors completely transformed our home and the quality of the installation exceeded expectations.

reviews.author: Eliana Lopes
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the flooring services in St. Pete. The installers were knowledgeable, respectful and detail oriented. The entire project was completed faster than expected and the floors look perfect.

reviews.author: Milena Sorrentino
reviews.text: Amazing flooring installation in Tampa. The crew worked efficiently, kept everything clean and delivered high quality results. The new floors completely changed the look of our house. Excellent flooring contractor in Tampa.

reviews.author: Jordina S. Rodriguez
reviews.text: Professional flooring company in Palmetto, FL. The team provided excellent customer service and high quality installation work. Everything was completed on time and the new flooring looks beautiful.

reviews.author: Priscila Queiroz
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with this flooring contractor in Sarasota. The communication was great throughout the entire project and the installation quality was outstanding. Highly recommend for flooring installation in Sarasota.

reviews.author: Luana Lyrio
reviews.text: Great experience with this flooring contractor in Venice, FL. The team was very professional, communicated well and completed the project on time. The floors look amazing and the installation quality was outstanding.

reviews.author: Luciano Dornfeld
reviews.text: Excellent flooring company in Sarasota. We hired them for new flooring installation and the entire process was smooth from start to finish. The crew was professional, punctual and paid close attention to detail. The workmanship exceeded expectations.

reviews.author: Nikolai Chmelev
reviews.text: Five stars — highly recommend Triangle Flooring.
